summary: HeartCore Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting that on April 20, 2026, Nasdaq Staff confirmed the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement (Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). No special situation — this is a routine compliance update after a previous deficiency notice. The stock will continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market. No transaction, activist campaign, or strategic change involved.
